# USDZ importer

Three.js 0.187.0 (MIT), https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r187
uses USDLoader, USDAParser, USDCParser, USDComposer, and its bundled fflate ZIP reader.

Reproduce with `npm ci --prefix tools && node tools/bundle-usdz.cjs`.
The checked-in bundle runs only in the offline conversion worker. The adapter
replaces DOM image loading with blob-only worker decoding and applies the USD
centimeter default when metersPerUnit is unauthored. Scene meshes are encoded
through the existing CVM bridge for native rendering and caching. No network
assets are fetched. The adapter also fills missing r187 inline double-vector decoding cases in the USDC parser, verified against OpenUSD-generated binary translations. The original library files are not modified.

The synthetic USDZ fixtures are original test data generated by
`tools/fixtures/usdz/generate.py` using OpenUSD's usd-core 26.11 Python package.
OpenUSD is a fixture-generation tool only and is not shipped in the APK.

Limitations: static preview; animation, cameras, lighting, per-vertex display
colors, and advanced material channels (normal/roughness/metallic/displacement)
are not displayed. Composition features are limited to those supported by the
pinned importer. Warnings are exposed in viewing notes. Embedded diffuse images
are preserved, and unsupported embedded image encodings are converted to PNG.
